Sezzle: Customer Service Agent
description: Headquarters: Colombia, Remote This is a remote position for candidates based in Bogota, Colombia. About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated Customer Agent who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. Are you passionate about driving customer success? Addicted to solving problems? So are we. We are looking for a customer-driven problem solver at Sezzle. With a fun, genuine, and empathetic voice, you will be troubleshooting and writing clear and concise instructions to solve questions about utilizing Sezzle. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You are dependable, resourceful, and get joy from going beyond to make customers successful. What You'll Do: • Provide clear, prompt, detailed, empathetic, and customer-oriented support to our consumers • Showcase passion and connection with the nooks and crannies product • Assist customers to resolve basic to complex inquiries via email, live chat, and phone call • Build a network of support and trust with our awesome customer support team! • Work with customers to understand how they use Sezzle services, and provide valuable feedback to Product and Development teams • Act as an advocate for our customers, report and act on observed areas for improvement in our product or processes • Actively seek solutions to customer needs, communicate trends to leadership, and suggest innovative solutions on behalf of the customer - experience What We Look For: • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills • Fluent in written and spoken English • Proven success in a fast-paced support environment • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to provide clear, articulate and kind customer support in technical instructions via phone support, email, and live chat • Able to efficiently manage multiple tasks at the same time and utilize personal judgment to take initiative • Driven to dig into the details of a system or process to solve customer problems • Displays a passion for what you do while upholding personal and corporate integrity • Excitement to learn new technologies and help customers succeed • 3+ years of customer support experience • Email, phone and/or live chat experience dealing with complex issues, troubleshooting, and problem resolution, preferably with software • Fluent in written and spoken English and Spanish (a third language is a pre) • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience • Zendesk, LiveAgent or Jira experience is a plus Work Conditions • Remote, work-from-home • Must work from Bogotá, Colombia, can't work outside of the country. • 3-4 training weeks • Full availability first 2 months, no vacations could be approved in this period • Fixed shift, based in Central Standard Time • Competitive salary, bonus structure Compensation and Benefits • Salary: $3.000.000 COP monthly • Benefits: • Remote role About You: • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome: At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. #Li-remote #full-time To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-customer-service-agent

title: Abnormal: AI Security Sales Executive, TOLA
description: Headquarters: Remote - USA *Ideal candidates will reside in the Dallas, Austin or Houston area. ABOUT THE ROLE AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market. The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close. • Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation. • Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume. • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most. • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch. • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table. • Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA. • Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing. • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace. WHAT YOU'LL SELL Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability: • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost. • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots. • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions. • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended. • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open. For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of personal quota attainment and winning new business. • Hands-on experience selling an AI product, with enough technical and product depth to run the sales cycle as the expert and give our product team credible feedback. • A record of selling in security or closely adjacent infrastructure. • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers. • A consultative, challenger style, paired with the hunter instincts to run strategic outbound into new logos. • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on. • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints. NICE TO HAVES • • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories. • Experience as an early seller or builder of a new motion: a first sales hire, a founding seller, or a new product line launched inside a larger company. • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders. • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals. Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $157,250 — $185,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please click here . If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/abnormal-ai-security-sales-executive-tola

title: SweetSpot Heating and Cooling: Creative Strategist (AI-Native, Direct Response)
description: Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do • Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. • Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. • Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. • Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. • Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. • Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. • Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for • Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. • A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. • Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. • AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. • Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. • Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. • Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure • Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. • Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. • Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) • Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). • Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. • Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. • Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. • Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

title: Abnormal: AI Security Sales Executive, North Central
description: Headquarters: Remote - USA ABOUT THE ROLE AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market. The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close. • Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation. • Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume. • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most. • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch. • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table. • Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA. • Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing. • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace. WHAT YOU'LL SELL Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability: • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost. • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots. • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions. • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended. • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open. For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of personal quota attainment and winning new business. • Hands-on experience selling an AI product, with enough technical and product depth to run the sales cycle as the expert and give our product team credible feedback. • A record of selling in security or closely adjacent infrastructure. • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers. • A consultative, challenger style, paired with the hunter instincts to run strategic outbound into new logos. • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on. • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints. NICE TO HAVES • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories. • Experience as an early seller or builder of a new motion: a first sales hire, a founding seller, or a new product line launched inside a larger company. • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders. • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals. Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $157,250 — $185,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our AI Solutions business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges through forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software and platforms, AI services, and AI-enabled transformation. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients move from AI strategy and experimentation into production, combining Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to achieve measurable business outcomes. This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who have successfully sold enterprise AI solutions and are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives. Enterprise AI has shifted rapidly from experimentation to execution. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes. The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production. Toptal brings together world-class AI and domain talent, forward-deployed solution delivery, AI platforms and capabilities, strategic technology partners, expert-in-the-loop operations, and managed services to help enterprises move from AI promise to production. This role exists to convert that market opportunity into new enterprise relationships and position Toptal as a strategic partner for companies deploying AI across their organizations. This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: *The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time. Net new accounts may begin with a specific AI initiative, workflow, platform implementation, or business problem requiring a disciplined approach to defining the opportunity and matching the right Toptal capabilities to the client’s needs. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units, workflows, technology platforms, and senior executive relationships. These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, understanding the client’s AI and technology environment, aligning solutions to evolving business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account while consistently driving measurable client value and long-term growth. • Own and build a portfolio of enterprise AI accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes. • Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish. • Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning. • Lead AI solution development and deal execution in partnership with AI Services leadership, Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Partnerships, and Delivery teams. • Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature. • Shape AI solutions that apply Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to clients’ most important business and operating challenges. • Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making. • Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. In the first week, expect to: • Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal. • Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities. • Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful. • Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks. • Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes. In the first month, expect to: • Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team. • Learn about the Toptal AI Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, solution portfolio, partner ecosystem, and client engagement model. • Work with AI Services leadership to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans. • Shadow key calls and client meetings. • Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing enterprise AI network and relationships, to articulate Toptal’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations move AI into production. • Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio. • Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategie

title: Custom Data Processing: Retail Support Specialist
description: Headquarters: Romeoville, Illinois, United States URL: https://workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/mdf/recruitment/recruitment.html?cid=e4d85aa2-30b6-4ecf-853d-99b7e8a6653c&ccId=9201073424092_2 Retail Support Specialist Employment Full-time, Exempt Location Remote Department Portfolio Management & Delivery Reports To Director, Training About CDP Custom Data Processing, Inc. (CDP) is a premier provider of data management systems and services for the public health community. Since 1979, we’ve delivered technology that makes a difference, from WIC services and electronic health records to environmental health and data analytics. Built on family values, we operate with integrity. Our diversified mix of solutions gives us a deeper perspective; one we use to understand the whole picture and serve public health professionals across the country. The Role As a Retail Support Specialist, you’ll help grocery stores and other WIC retailers accept WIC benefits through our WIC Direct EBT system. You’ll work support tickets from retailers, state agencies and third party processors, help test and certify point-of-sale (POS) systems, and support special projects like WIC online shopping. What You’ll Do Support tickets and retailer support • Work support tickets from retailers, state agencies and WIC online shopping customers, and troubleshoot POS issues until they’re resolved • Train retailers, answer their questions, provide APL support, and activate or deactivate WIC Direct accounts • Ensure tickets are resolved based on CDP standards • Review data and run audits to keep the master retailer list in WIC Direct accurate POS testing and certification/ validation • Help test and certify integrated POS systems for new and existing CDP customers • Load benefits onto test cards so POS providers can run their certification transactions • Work with store corporate contacts, POS providers, payment processors and state vendor units to keep systems updated, certified and ready for WIC EBT transactions Special projects • Support special projects such as WIC online shopping, helping new and existing online retailers get set up and transacting • Stay with customers as they move from implementation into day-to-day operations, so nothing falls through the cracks The Ideal Candidate • You are a natural troubleshooter. When a POS system rejects a transaction, you dig in until you find the root cause, not just a workaround. • You are organized with a busy ticket queue. You track every open issue, follow up without being asked, and close the loop with retailers and state agencies. • You are a clear communicator. You can walk a store manager through a fix and explain the same issue to a payment processor’s technical team. • You are curious about new technology. Projects like WIC online shopping excite you, and you pick up new systems quickly. • You care about CDP’s mission and the families who rely on WIC to put healthy food on the table. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science or a related field, or equivalent work experience. • 3 years of experience troubleshooting and resolving issues with POS devices. • Knowledge of POS systems, payment processors and testing methods • Clear, patient communicator who can adjust their style to the person in front of them, moving between technical and non-technical communication. • WIC transaction process knowledge, including Federal rules and regulations • Ability to travel frequently, including overnight stays. Nice to Have • Experience working a ticket queue in a help desk or service management tool • Experience supporting e-commerce or online ordering platforms Compensation & Benefits The salary range for this position is $60,000 – $72,000. Actual compensation within that range is based on factors unique to each candidate during the hiring process. CDP also offers a comprehensive benefits package and meaningful opportunities for growth and advancement within the company. This is a remote position open and open immediately. Our Culture At our core, we value our relationships, both internally and externally. We respect everyone’s contributions: our staff and customers all have a seat at the table. We listen, we comment, and we decide our way forward based on what is best for all. Our relationships are paramount because they determine our long-term success. When everyone feels empowered, everyone succeeds. Ready to make an impact? Apply today through our careers page at cdpehs.com/working-at-cdp Equal Opportunity Employer It is the policy of Custom Data Processing, Inc. to ensure that applicants are considered and employees are treated fairly during their employment, without regard to race, color, religion, age, physical or mental disability, sex, marital status, ancestry, national origin, veteran’s status, citizenship, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to all employment actions, including hiring, promotion, demotion, transfer, recruitment, layoff, termination, compensation, and selection for training. We are committed to maintaining a work environment free of harassment, intimidation, and coercion at all sites and facilities. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/custom-data-processing-retail-support-specialist
